Package neqsim.process.engineering.dexpi

Class Dexpi201PidMaterializer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.dexpi.Dexpi201PidMaterializer
public final class Dexpi201PidMaterializer extends Object
Projects declared P&ID proposal functions and physical attachments into native DEXPI 2.0.1.

Inline devices split the actual source pipe. Explicit auxiliary routes introduce connected tee nodes. Missing route evidence is retained as a HOLD rather than a disconnected tagged object. A projected design proposal does not implement its simulation or approve its engineering design.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team
